svg.title: One read of a GitHub thread instead of a tool call per piece
svg.desc: Left: an agent reading a thread itself makes one tool call for the issue, its comments, the linked pull request, the reviews, the checks and a failed log, and each call carries the conversation so far. Right: codenib threads prepares one document with status, coverage, the ask, code locations, failing CI, other open pull requests on the same code, linked threads and discussion, ending in a cursor, so a later read returns only what changed. On 76 pull request takeovers, input tokens against reading with gh fell 21% with Codex (gpt-6.1-sol) and 45% with Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5). Over the life of an issue, a first context and updates took a median of 2,897 tokens against 21,103 for rereading the thread, on 151 issues.
